items.heading: These Are Separate From Evaluating
items.text: These are separate from evaluating the counselling process or provider, they're about the site itself, before you've even spoken to anyone.

items.heading: A Site Can Look Trustworthy
items.text: A site can look trustworthy and still be built to extract your details before it gives you anything real. These four signs are about the website as a property, separate from the usual red flags, outdated advice, guaranteed outcomes.

items.heading: Named, Checkable Authors Are
items.text: Named, checkable authors are a stronger accountability signal than an anonymous "our team" byline.

items.heading: Pricing Shown Directly
items.text: Pricing shown directly on the page lets you compare cost fairly before you commit time to a call.

items.heading: A Trustworthy Site Avoids Guaranteed
items.text: A trustworthy site avoids guaranteed outcomes and shows what it actually does and what it cannot do.
